question: The Defense Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) lab in which city has created an advanced polymeric membrane designed for high-pressure desalination of sea water in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Defense Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**, a premier agency under the Ministry of Defence in India, developed an advanced polymeric membrane to aid in **high-pressure desalination of seawater**.
 
• This innovation was carried out by the **DRDO laboratory in Kanpur**, known for its expertise in developing advanced materials and technology solutions.
 
• The polymeric membrane developed is designed to withstand **high-pressure applications**, making it suitable for efficient desalination processes, essential for producing potable water from seawater.
 
• The technology is expected to contribute significantly to **India's efforts** in addressing water scarcity, particularly in coastal regions, by providing an affordable and sustainable solution.
 
• The development aligns with India's focus on leveraging **indigenous technology** to solve critical environmental and resource challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Defense Research and Development Organisation (DRDO):**

 
 
• Established in **1958**, DRDO works under the Ministry of Defence to develop state-of-the-art technologies for India's defense and strategic applications.
 
• It operates a network of **50 laboratories** specializing in fields like aeronautics, armaments, electronics, and advanced materials.
 
• DRDO has been instrumental in developing indigenous technologies such as the **Agni missile series, BrahMos missile system, and Tejas fighter aircraft**.
 
 
 
• **Polymeric Membranes:**
 
 
• A polymeric membrane is a synthetic material used for **separation processes**, including desalination, filtration, and purification.
 
• They are known for their **high efficiency, durability, and ability to operate in extreme pressure conditions**.
 
• Such membranes are widely used in **reverse osmosis desalination plants**, which convert saline water into potable water.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Desalination:**
 
 
• Desalination is the process of removing salts and other impurities from seawater to produce **freshwater**.
 
• It is critical for addressing **water scarcity**, especially in regions with limited freshwater resources.
 
• India has been investing in desalination technologies to cater to the needs of its growing population and industries.
 
 
 
• **Kanpur - A Hub for Advanced Research:**
 
 
• Kanpur is home to several prestigious research institutions, including the **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT Kanpur)**, which contributes to innovations in technology and science.
 
• The city has emerged as a center for advancements in **material science and engineering**, making it an ideal location for a DRDO lab focused on polymeric innovations.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Water Scarcity in India:**

 
 
• India is one of the most water-stressed countries in the world, with a per capita water availability of **1,544 cubic meters** as of 2020.
 
• Desalination technologies could provide a sustainable solution to meet the water demand in coastal and urban areas.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives:**
 
 
• The Indian government has launched several schemes like the **National Water Mission** and **Atal Bhujal Yojana** to manage water resources efficiently.
 
• Investments in desalination and water treatment technologies are part of India's broader strategy to ensure **water security**.
